GSC clicks held 8 to 8 (6 of 8 brand: dx living 4, dxliving 2); impressions 168 to 396 but average position fell 8.5 to 26.7 because the gain sits at deep positions (3d-rendering-services-melbourne 144 impressions at position 46.2). 28 days: 27 clicks, 885 impressions. weeks.notes_en: Scheduled run on 12 Oct. GSC clicks 4 to 8 and impressions 144 to 168, but 7 of 8 clicks were brand queries (dxliving 4, dx living 3); average position flat at 8.5. 28-day position 30.8 to 12.0 because deep-position impressions rolled out of the window, not because rankings improved. GA4 160 sessions; key events 4 to 0; 726 page views inflated by a few users (/about-new 222 views from 3 users). AI citations 18 to 12 (ChatGPT 7 to 4, Copilot 11 to 8); GA4 AI 5 sessions. Ahrefs and AI citations come from the 9 Oct snapshot.

weeks.notes_en: Scheduled run on 5 Oct. GSC clicks 7 to 4, impressions 177 to 144, no clicks from 29 Sep to 2 Oct; average position 12.8 to 8.5 because 22 deep queries (44 impressions at 32.3) left the sample, not because rankings improved. GA4 154 sessions; google / organic 13 to 28, opposite to GSC; 4 key events, 2 from Organic Search (event name not re-read). AI citations 12 to 18 on Copilot 5 to 11. Ahrefs and AI citations come from the 2 Oct snapshot.

GA4 186 sessions and the first 3 generate_lead key events (2 users, all Direct, unverified). GA4 Organic Search 37 to 16, opposite to GSC. AI citations 18 to 12. weeks.notes_vi: Dung bu ngay 21/09. Toan bo cum truy van melbourne ve 0 impression, thay bang Sydney/Brisbane/Adelaide va cap quoc gia — vi the vi tri TB nhay 30,7 xuong 17,2 trong khi impressions va clicks cung giam. Direct tang 37 len 63 session voi thoi luong 2 giay, can kiem tra bot. Khong con session AI nao. Ahrefs va trich dan AI lay tu snapshot 18/09.
weeks.notes_en: Backfilled on 21 Sep. The whole melbourne query cluster went to zero impressions, replaced by Sydney/Brisbane/Adelaide and national variants — which is why average position jumped 30.7 to 17.2 while impressions and clicks both fell. Direct rose 37 to 63 sessions at 2 seconds each and needs a bot check. No AI sessions at all. Ahrefs and AI citations come from the 18 Sep snapshot.

weeks.notes_vi: Dung bu ngay 21/09 — tuan nay le ra duoc quet 14/09 nhung bao cao tuan khi do chi tra ket qua ra chat, khong tao file. GSC va GA4 doc lai truc tiep cho dung cua so; Ahrefs va trich dan AI lay tu snapshot 11/09. Nam bai moi lot thang vao top 10 nhung moi bai chi 2-12 impressions. stage.dxliving.com van chua sua.

weeks.notes_vi: GSC trễ 3 ngày, mới nhất 04/09. Su co 404 tuan truoc da khac phuc: ca 16 URL bai viet tro lai HTTP 200. Phan lon bien dong tuan nay la hau qua cua viec Google index lai cac trang do. stage.dxliving.com van chua sua.
weeks.notes_en: GSC lags 3 days; latest data 4 Sep. The 404 incident is resolved: all 16 article URLs return HTTP 200 again. Most of this week's movement is fallout from Google re-indexing those pages. stage.dxliving.com is still unfixed.

weeks.notes_vi: GSC trễ 3 ngày, mới nhất 28/08. Cửa sổ chồng 1 ngày (22/08) với tuần trước. GA4 đã so sánh được vì cả hai tuần đều sau khi tracking khôi phục 15/08. Ahrefs cảnh báo 'Google keyword ranking data disruption' ngày 28/08.
weeks.notes_en: GSC lags 3 days; latest data 28 Aug. The window overlaps the prior week by one day (22 Aug). GA4 is comparable because both weeks sit after tracking was restored on 15 Aug. Ahrefs posted a 'Google keyword ranking data disruption' notice on 28 Aug.

weeks.notes_en: GSC lags 2 days, so a rolling 7-day window ending 22 Aug is used. GA4 tracking was down 27 Jul–14 Aug, so week-over-week is not comparable.
